QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`, the installed functions wrap the heap in a mutex (`:541-563`). ... `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` ... installs its own pair through the runtime setter (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:572-575`)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the installed functions use a mutex under MBEDTLS_THREADING_C, but it never says a plain pair is installed otherwise, nor that the choice is made at compile time inside the init function.
